newsitem.title: USA: First Republic Bancorp says not for sale.
newsitem.headline: First Republic Bancorp says not for sale.

text.p: First Republic Bancorp Inc of San Francisco on Thursday said it told its investment banker, Montgomery Securities, to end a search for a company to buy the bank.
First Republic said in a statement it was still considering strategic alliances, which could include the acquisition of another company.

The company also said it increased the number of shares it was authorized to repurchase by up to 500,000 shares. The bank is authorized to buy back 170,000 shares under an existing program. It has about 10,030,000 shares outstanding.
